name: Cash Flow Inventory
description_en:
Cash Flow Inventory combines stock control with built-in accounting, POS, payroll and production functions for smaller businesses. Its public feature page includes purchase and sales flows, a general ledger, bills of materials and work orders.

The attraction is a shared operational record across goods and finances. Adoption requires checking whether its transaction model, tax settings and production costing fit the business rather than assuming an all-in-one label resolves local accounting requirements.
description_zh:
Cash Flow Inventory 将库存控制与内置会计、POS、薪资及生产功能结合，面向较小企业。公开功能页包括采购销售流程、总账、物料清单和工单。

其价值在于让货物流和财务共用运营记录。采用前应检查交易模型、税务设置和生产成本是否符合业务，不能仅凭一体化定位认定其满足当地会计要求。

core_features.explanation_en: The vendor documents inventory alongside built-in general ledger, payables and receivables.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商在库存之外说明内置总账、应付和应收功能。

core_features.explanation_en: BOMs, work orders, material issues and finished-goods receipts are described.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档描述物料清单、工单、领料及成品入库。

sections.title_en: Reconcile receipt, sale and financial posting
sections.title_zh: 核对收货、销售与财务记录
sections.en: Use a sample purchase order to receive goods, then sell part of the quantity and compare stock balances with financial reports. For production, issue materials against a BOM and receive the finished item before assessing cost visibility. These are evaluation steps; posting behavior, reversals and period-close controls were not executed.
sections.zh: 可用样本采购单收货，再销售部分数量，比较库存余额与财务报表。生产场景可按物料清单领料并接收成品后检查成本。这些是评估步骤；过账、冲销和关账控制尚未实际执行。

sections.title_en: Choose by location, user, item and order limits
sections.title_zh: 按地点、用户、商品及订单上限选择
sections.en: All plans are advertised as including all features, with capacity as the differentiator. Free permits two locations, two users, 50 items and 30 purchase plus 30 sales orders monthly. Basic allows 2/5/200 and 1,500 of each order type; Standard 5/10/1,500 and 10,000; Premium 15/30/5,000 and 30,000. Confirm how canceled orders and variants count before sizing a plan.
sections.zh: 所有方案宣传包含全部功能，区别在容量。Free 含两个地点、两个用户、50 商品，每月各 30 张采购单和销售单。Basic 对应 2/5/200、两类订单各 1,500；Standard 为 5/10/1,500、各 10,000；Premium 为 15/30/5,000、各 30,000。选型前应确认取消订单和商品变体的计数方法。

sections.title_zh: 年付金额对应预付承诺
sections.en: Basic, Standard and Premium cost $69/$129/$249 on monthly billing. Annual billing is paid 12 months upfront, with monthly equivalents of $49/$99/$225. Free is explicitly described as permanent within limits, rather than a timed paid trial. Custom development, third-party integrations and enterprise setups are quote-led.
sections.zh: Basic、Standard、Premium 月付为 $69/$129/$249；年付需预付 12 个月，月均 $49/$99/$225。Free 明确为限额内长期免费，而非限时付费试用。定制开发、第三方集成和企业部署需询价。

sections.title_en: Validate local operations before consolidating systems
sections.title_zh: 整合系统前验证本地业务
sections.en: A retailer, wholesaler or small manufacturer seeking stock and financial visibility can evaluate the combined scope. AI import and demand forecasting are vendor-described aids, not independently measured accuracy. Use difficult supplier documents and seasonal items in a test. Public global-compliance language does not establish jurisdiction-specific tax certification or payroll suitability.
sections.zh: 希望同时查看库存与财务的零售、批发或小型制造企业可评估其组合范围。AI 导入和需求预测属于厂商描述，准确性未独立测量；应使用难解析供应商文件和季节性商品测试。公开的全球合规宣传不能证明特定辖区税务认证或薪资适用性。
